translated_pages.text:
U.S. Immigration Services Department
Office of Immigration Fees and Penalties
Date: September 29, 2026
FINAL WARNING - IMMIGRATION FEE PAST DUE
Dear Applicant,
Our records show you owe an unpaid immigration processing fee of $950.
You must pay today with Google Play gift cards or you will be deported unless payment is received within 48 hours.
Call Officer Daniel Sample at (202) 555-0147 and read the gift card numbers over the phone.
USCIS payment portal: www.uscis-fee-payment.example.com
Do not tell anyone about this letter. Keep this matter confidential.

summary_title: Letter that asks for gift cards and says it is from immigration
summary_body: This letter says it is from the "U.S. Immigration Services Department". It asks for $950 in Google Play gift cards and threatens deportation. I could not match this to a known kind of paper.
summary_body_en: This letter says it is from the "U.S. Immigration Services Department". It asks for $950 in Google Play gift cards and threatens deportation. I could not match this to a known kind of paper.

demands.source_quote: Our records show you owe an unpaid immigration processing fee of $950.

plan_steps.text: Do not pay and do not call the number on this letter. Check with the real agency through Get help.
A licensed lawyer or a DOJ-accredited representative can tell you what the real agency needs.
Keep the letter and the envelope. They can help when you report it.

glossary.explanation: Store cards with money on them. Real agencies do not take them as payment.

red_flags.text: The letter asks for payment with gift cards.
red_flags.source_quote: You must pay today with Google Play gift cards

red_flags.text: The letter uses an agency name that does not match the real immigration office, and its website does not end in .gov.
The letter tells you to keep it secret and pay fast.
red_flags.source_quote: Do not tell anyone about this letter.
